privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must add three prefixes: Mx., Prof., and Engr. It must add four ethnic codes: MENA (Middle Eastern or North African), NHPI (Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander), SEA (Southeast Asian), and MRAC (Multiracial). It must add two employment statuses: Seasonal Worker and Fellowship. Finally, it must onboard two employees: Jordan Rivera (EMP021, Customer Support) and Rajan Patel (EMP022, Engineering). All actions must be performed via the Sentrifugo web GUI.
